title: Perrin Fertha
subtitle: Independent
description: As the husband and consort of Senator Mon Mothma, Perrin Fertha was well aware of the complicated politics of Coruscant, he simply didn't care for them. Charming but superficial, he's a polar opposite to his wife's idealism and secret rebellion. He enjoyed the trappings and luxuries of his life, even if he had to play games to maintain them.
